cards.description:
This branch evaluates instances of Heritage Resource E18 and Heritage Resource Group E27, and is based on the City of Los Angeles' SurveyLA survey methodology for evaluation of  significance and eligibility for designation as a heritage resource or heritage resource group. Evaluation consists of defining a historic context (Evaluation Criteria) which triggers specific eligibility requirements (Eligibility Requirements) and results in the selection of one or more status codes (Status) and the writing of a reasons statement (Reasons). The branch also contains nodes to record the date of Evaluation, the dates defining the Period of Significance for evaluation.

Relates to E18 and E27 resource models via P140i.
cards.name: Evaluation

cards.description: Describes the conditions, threats, and disturbances affecting a Heritage Resource or Heritage Resource Group. Additional information may include a management recommendation, a condition image, the data the condition was assessed and a description of the condition.
cards.helptext:
Threat Type and Disturbance Type work from the UNESCO Primary Threats list. Multiple options can be selected.

Threat types from UNESCO (https://whc.unesco.org/en/factors/) - also used for classifying disturbance at sites, where disturbance is taken to be threats which have occurred or are in process which have impacted the resource, compared to threats which are likely to apply in future and are risks to the resource but which have not produced significant impacts (yet).

Example application:

  • Stone robbing threat would be categorised as "Other Human Activities > Illegal Activities"

 

  • Road built nearby would be categorised as "Transportation Infrastructure > Ground Transport Infrastructure"

 

 

  • Nearby stream washing away part of site would be categorised as "Local Conditions Affecting Physical Fabric > Water (rain / water table)"

 

  • For "erosion" of a site, go to the category "Local Conditions Affecting Physical Fabric" and choose one or more from the likely options of:
    • Radiation / light
    • Temperature
    • Water (rain / water table)
    • Wind
    • Relative Humidity
cards.instructions: One assessment of condition at a particular point in time.
